title: Privacy Policy | Hazlo Sano
description: Privacy Policy for Hazlo Sano - Wellness Chatbot
subtitle: Hazlo Sano - Wellness Chatbot
intro: At Hazlo Sano we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect information when you interact with our chatbot via WhatsApp.

section1.title: Information we collect
section1.intro: When you use our chatbot, we may collect the following information:
items: The messages you send to the chatbot.
Information you voluntarily share related to sleep, diet, exercise, or emotional well-being habits.
Basic technical data necessary for the operation of the service (such as date and time of interaction).
section1.warning: We do not intentionally request sensitive medical information or financial data through the chatbot.

section2.title: How we use your information
section2.intro: We use the collected information to:
items: Provide educational content on the 4 pillars of health: sleep, healthy eating, exercise, and emotional well-being.
Recommend products or services related to healthy habits.
Improve the user experience and chatbot functionality.

section3.title: Informational nature of the service
items: The Hazlo Sano chatbot provides information for educational and general wellness purposes.
We do not offer medical diagnoses, treatments, or professional health advice.
The use of the chatbot does not create a doctor-patient relationship.
section3.warning: If you are experiencing a medical or psychological emergency, we recommend you seek out a qualified health professional.

section4.title: Information sharing
section4.boldText: We do not sell your personal information.
section4.intro: We may only share information with:
items: Technology providers necessary to operate the service (e.g., cloud infrastructure).
Official messaging platforms like WhatsApp, owned by Meta.
Competent authorities when required by law.

section5.title: Storage and security
section5.p1: We implement reasonable technical and administrative security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
section5.p2: However, no digital system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

section6.title: Data retention
section6.p1: We retain information only for the time necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy or as required by law.

section7.title: User rights
section7.intro: You can request at any time:
items: Access to the information we hold about you.

section8.title: Use by minors
section8.p1: The service is directed to people over 18 years of age. We do not intentionally collect information from minors.

section9.title: Changes to this policy
section9.p1: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Modifications will be published on this same page with the date of the update.
